$comment: Four Seasons to-go menu. Prices are integer cents (1075 = $10.75). Edit with care; run `npm run validate:menu` after every change. See docs/MENU_MANAGEMENT.md.

meta.title: To-Go Menu
meta.source: Transcribed in the earlier site prototype (legacy/index.html), which labels these as in-store prices from the printed menu, July 2026. Not yet checked against the original printed menu by the owner.
notes: Dishes marked “spice level” can be made no spice, mild, medium, spicy or extra spicy (extra spicy +$1.00).
Entrées come with steamed rice unless noted; pork fried rice instead is +$2.00.
Substitutions on combination plates and family dinners are $1.50 each; removing an item is free.
